title: China's Rarest Silk Grows Just 5cm a Day | China Travel Expert
description:
Two masters at one loom, a full day of work — and only about five centimeters of finished cloth. This is Nanjing Yunjin, "cloud brocade."

Yunjin weaving needs two artisans on a single tall pattern loom: one sits above adjusting the warp, the other below inserting the weft and threading in real gold and peacock-feather colors. Together they produce only 5–6 cm a day — no machine can replicate the technique. It was the designated silk of the imperial courts of the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties, and in 2009 UNESCO inscribed the craftsmanship of Nanjing Yunjin on its Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

🧭 Expert Tip: See it woven live at the Nanjing Yunjin Museum — watching the two-person loom in motion is the whole point.

中国最贵的丝，一天只织5厘米——两个人一台织机，全手工。
